title: Conversion at 2 s: native VCell vs co-sim
caption: Top: mid-plane slice with the membrane. Bottom: B on the cut-away membrane with the A particles.
simulations: One seed per solver and case, recorded every 0.25 s into results bundles (sims/render_3d.py): conversion to 2 s, exchange to 5 s. Native particles are placed at their nodes from VCell's per-node counts; its membrane is VCell's smooth surface.
interpretation: Both solvers spread B uniformly. The staircase panel shows VCell's PDE domain; the co-sim's is the body-fitted mesh inside the same ball.
